Comment: Serve Esa-FX/wiki hover graph on docmost EC2 :8080

commands: token=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id esafx/production/github-clone --region $REGION --query SecretString --output text)

if [[ -d $ROOT/.git ]]; then git -C $ROOT remote set-url origin "$url"; git -C $ROOT fetch origin $BRANCH; git -C $ROOT checkout $BRANCH; git -C $ROOT reset --hard origin/$BRANCH; else sudo rm -rf $ROOT; git clone --branch $BRANCH --depth 1 "$url" $ROOT; fi
for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8080/ >/dev/null && echo wiki-graph-health-ok && exit 0; sleep 1; done
